_comment: Single source of the anti-sleep auto-clicker matching defaults (Ctrl+M, sg_actions.activity_simulation), read by the three drivers and the library window. threshold is the least normalised cross-correlation of an image match (0 to 1) when an image sets none, within threshold_min and threshold_max. scales are the power-of-two factors a library image is also tried at, for a button captured on a 1x screen and matched on a 2x one or the reverse. The coarse_* keys bound the coarse-to-fine search (_shared/shortcuts/engine/auto_click_matcher.lua). text_max_distance is the edit distance a new text target admits. library_folder is the folder of the library under the configuration folder, library_index its presets file. Allowed apps and the keep-awake and auto-click switches belong to each preset (keep_awake_presets.json). The tick and the cooldown are durations: they live in the timings registry ([keep_awake] auto_click_tick_ms and auto_click_cooldown_ms).
